tier_description: Utility - Worktree-isolated GitHub Flow (8 commands, v2 response contract). Mode A staged isolation + Mode B PLAN.md-based worktree shipping. 100% preservation of unstaged/untracked files, fail-loud finalize.

preflight_checks.description: init: main freshness + staged changes present + secret files blocked + gh auth + concurrency lock (30s flag mtime)
init: CI Mirror Gate (make q.ci-mirror, 60min stamp freshness)
ship-worktree: PLAN.md validation (strips code blocks/HTML comments, recognizes cancelled markers) + committed/clean worktree check (commit_required)

postflight_checks.description: ship-feature completed (merged === true or graceful pending === true)
finalize completed (sync_status === 'synced' or intended fail-loud response)
cleanup-worktree completed with sync_status === 'synced' or intended fail-loud response (local_changes/ff_failed/fetch_failed)

references.description: Branch completion options reference aligned with create-pr Mode B and destructive guard policies.
Merge conflict 5-step protocol (investigate intent → preserve both → verify) without aborting — adapted for R-CM-034 multi-worktree reconcile.
